messages:
maria: Quick async check — Lighthouse sprint status (kernel perf + continuous batching + KV warmup).

maria: TL;DR: kernel PR #421 merged to main at 09:14, staging canary running on 3 pods. Need infra bump to 6 pods for throughput test. KV warmup branch has promising numbers.
aj: link to PR? :eyes:
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421 — contains microkernel shim + seq-aware batching toggle
devin: saw a tail-latency bump in staging at seq>1024, isolating. putting logs in gist.
maria: @devops-oncall can we schedule a quick capacity bump today? sam can you take?
sam: I can do the bump at 16:00 PT. need the runbook snippet — don't want to disrupt dedicated clusters.
maria: runbook snippet below — do a dry-run first
```bash
# increase canary nodes
kubectl scale deployment/runtime-canary -n prod --replicas=6
kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime-canary -n prod
# toggle seq-aware batching for canary
kubectl set env deployment/runtime-canary BATCH_SEQ_AWARE=true
```
olga: KV warmup: pushed kv/warmup-optim with eviction=0.6, async-prefetch enabled. Coldstart p50 down from 2.1s -> 1.3s on x1 test (see perf gist).
devin: thanks olga — can you paste the perf command you used?
olga: perf command: `./perf/run.sh --model=gpt-small --seq=512,2048 --load=50rps` ; I'll add results to the sprint doc.
aj: owners for the next steps?
maria: owners: kernel=maria, kv=olga, infra=sam, metrics=devin. I'll own rollout coordination. cc: @devops-oncall
infra-bot: deploybot: canary rollout started (runtime-canary -> 6 replicas) by sam at 16:03 UTC :rocket:
sam: started the bump. monitoring dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/services/runtime-canary
devin: looking at p99 traces now — initial spike but tail stabilizing after cache warms (15m). will post summary.
olga: will open a follow-up PR to add prefetch config flag to console
maria: thanks all. if no blockers, plan: full canary run through EOD, then A/B for 2 hours tomorrow morning. Post any PRs or perf notes here. :thumbsup:
